corrections.title: Downgrade 3v3 The Stranger BANE counter to C / 48 after repeated defeats
corrections.rationale: Owner-approved GAC-BANE-STR1 Option A: downgrade the exact 3v3 The Stranger defence versus the BANE counter (Darth Bane plus one other Sith, excluding SEE) from S/50 to C/48, non-provisional, undersize preserved at 1. Targeted data correction after repeated recent outright defeats; the Rule of Two composition note from C02 is preserved and the approved reliability warning is appended.

evidence.supports: Owner approval of GAC-BANE-STR1 Option A: downgrade the 3v3 The Stranger BANE counter from S/50 to C/48, non-provisional, undersize 1 preserved, with the stated reliability note.

provenance.conditions: 3v3: The Stranger defence; BANE attacking counter (Darth Bane plus one other non-summoned Sith ally, excluding SEE and SEE_BANE). Full defence composition, relics, mods, omicrons and datacrons not recorded.
provenance.confidence: Medium for owner-observed repeated outright failures and the explicitly approved reassessment; no statistical win rate is claimed.
provenance.limitations: Two recent reported attempts with unspecified battle conditions: the most recent defeated one enemy, the preceding attempt defeated none. C/48 is an owner-approved low-end planning estimate for successful wins, not banners earned in the failed attempts. Distinct SEE (B/52) and SEE_BANE (S/53) records and all other Bane and 5v5 entries are unchanged.
